main_visual_concept: Physical Mechanical Demonstration of Keterikatan Kuantum
metaphor_world: Classic educational workbench with modular test apparatus and calibrated dials.
lighting_direction: Directional key light positioned at top-left (angle 45° elevation, 35° azimuth). Casts gentle, tiered paper drop shadows (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22) with 6-12px diffusion). Zero digital airbrushing or harsh computer-generated gradient fills; shading is constructed exclusively by stacking darker tone cutout strips beneath lit surfaces.

character_appearance.name: CatScientist
character_appearance.wardrobe: Crisp white paper lab coat with folded lapels (#F8FAFC)
character_appearance.expression_rules: Always actively looking at or interacting with central apparatus; never idle.

illustration_style: Artisanal multi-layered 2D construction paper collage with tactile stop-motion aesthetics. Every element appears physically die-cut or scissor-cut from heavyweight matte paper cardstock (250-300 gsm) featuring subtle deckle edges, 1px lighter top-left paper fiber rims, and soft, realistic multi-plane drop shadows.
recurring_visual_motifs: Die-cut measurement indicators with high-contrast tick marks
Tactile papercraft gear assemblies and mechanical levers
Four-point paper sparkle bursts celebrating scientific realization
visual_continuity_rules: 100% adherence to digital cut-paper collage aesthetic; zero 3D CGI or raw pixel textures.
Never display raw numbers or claims as plain text; always embody measurements through animated apparatus.
Cat Scientist mascot must maintain #EA580C warm orange fur, wire spectacles, and white lab coat.
Maintain consistent floor_y = 1380 anchor across all laboratory and environmental staging.
Preserve vertical safe zones: banner top 420px, captions bottom 500px, stage central 1160px.
